result.one_liner: Open-source CLI tool that searches for usernames across 400+ social media sites and websites

evidence.quote: Uses direct HTTP requests to publicly available URLs without authentication
Primary interface is command-line tool; no official maintained API
Searches across 400+ social networks and websites
Experimental REST API exists but has not been actively maintained since 2021

result.notes: Sherlock is an open-source CLI tool requiring no credentials. An experimental REST API exists but is unmaintained. Third-party wrappers like Apify provide REST API access with their own credentials. Agents can invoke Sherlock via CLI subprocess, but lack of an official maintained API makes integration suboptimal.
